score.title: Attendance score (last {{n}} days)

gradeHint.B: Good. Tell us as early as you can.
gradeHint.C: A manager will talk with you. Tell us early when you are absent or late.
gradeHint.D: A manager will talk with you.

rules: You start at 100. The points of the last 90 days are added (max 100).
Day off: told by the day before + a replacement 0 / no replacement −1
Day off: told on the day, 2 h or more before the start −3 / less than 2 h −5
Day off: told after the start or not at all (no-show) −10
Late: up to 15 min −1 / longer −2. Told after the start or not at all: another −2
Paid leave and store reasons are 0. Even when sick, telling early keeps your score.
Covering for someone +2 / a full month without absence +3
A 95+ / B 85–94 / C 70–84 (talk with a manager) / D below 70
